tools.name: visual_list_templates
tools.description: List all Synth Desktop visual templates (id, title, genre, slots).

genre.description: Optional genre filter (craftax, posttrain, reward, annotation, compare, live)

tools.name: visual_create_from_template
tools.description: Create a VisualInstance from a template id with optional title and initial props. Does not bind data yet.

instance_id.description: Optional stable instance id; auto-generated if omitted

tools.name: visual_bind_data_source
tools.description: Bind a data source to a template slot on an existing VisualInstance (trace_v5 | local_cas | live_sse | fixture).

source.description: Digest, CAS path, SSE URL, or fixture relative path

path.description: Optional JSON pointer / dotted path into the payload

tools.name: visual_save_tsx
tools.description: Serialize a VisualInstance shell to visuals/instances/<id>.tsx and mark status=saved.

tools.name: visual_open_in_pane
tools.description: Open (or focus) a VisualInstance in the Desktop visual pane.

tsx_path.description: Optional path under visuals/ if opening a saved shell directly

tools.name: visual_stream_live_eval
tools.description: Attach a live SSE (or fixture replay) stream to a live.* visual instance and open it in the pane.

template_id.description: Which live template to use; creates instance if instance_id omitted

sse_url.description: Live SSE URL for eval/dock/intern events

fixture.description: Fixture path for offline replay (mutually exclusive with sse_url in demos)
